headline: An identity.* modeling-rule sweep touches 26 packs; Flashpoint 2.2.4 is the day's one real release
summary_md:
- Six of the day's ten upstream commits are the same sweep — CRTX-271525 and CRTX-271527, "add identity.* to modeling rules", PRs 2 through 6 of 7.
- 26 of the 30 packs that moved added lines against **exactly one deletion each**, the shape of that sweep: new modeling-rule content plus a version bump.
- **Flashpoint** 2.2.4 is the exception and the largest change, +1,629/-60.
- Three genuine fixes landed: **MailListener - POP3** date parsing, **XSOARmirroring** re-enabling `get-modified-remote-data`, and a reset/refresh-token ordering fix.
- 30 packs in total, 6,177 lines added against 96 removed.

highlights.title: identity.* is being added to modeling rules across the catalog, five PRs at a time
highlights.detail: PRs 2 through 6 of a series of 7 landed on one day under CRTX-271525 and CRTX-271527, which accounts for 26 of the 30 packs and all but one of the day's large additions.

highlights.title: Flashpoint Release 2.2.4
highlights.detail: The day's biggest pack change at +1,629/-60, and the only one removing more than four lines, so the only pack whose existing content was reworked rather than extended.

highlights.title: MailListener POP3 no longer fails to fetch on a date format
highlights.detail: XSUP-75797, a support-raised fetch error, fixed in 89 lines against 3 removed.

highlights.title: XSOAR mirroring re-enables get-modified-remote-data
highlights.detail: A command that had been turned off is switched back on (+41/-4), which changes how mirrored incidents refresh.

highlights.title: A reset command now runs before the refresh token is fetched
highlights.detail: The day's one unclaimed subject, and MicrosoftManagementActivity is the only remaining pack with more than one deletion (+45/-3).

items.Packs/Flashpoint: Release 2.2.4, the day's largest change and the only substantial rework (+1,629/-60).
items.Packs/MailListener_-_POP3: Fixes the XSUP-75797 POP3 fetch error caused by a date format (+89/-3).
items.Packs/MicrosoftManagementActivity: Reorders the reset command to run before the refresh token is obtained (+45/-3).
items.Packs/AzureKubernetesServices: Largest pack of the identity.* modeling-rule sweep at +517/-1.
